basic_info.description: Truly inspiring ARCHITECTURAL design, impressive exterior and interior size, PANORAMIC VIEWS and a TRANQUIL location in the HISTORIC Lone Mountain neighborhood are yours, here at 288 Willard North. GORGEOUS primary bedroom suite has PANO-VU deck, gas frplc. & coved windows. GREAT ROOM has fabulous natural light w/ 20 WINDOWS, 2 Decks, L.R. w/ gas fireplace, Hrwd.
